newsitem.title: VIETNAM: Vietnam cuts ceiling on dong/dollar interest rates.
newsitem.headline: Vietnam cuts ceiling on dong/dollar interest rates.

text.p: The central State Bank of Vietnam said on Monday that it was lowering the ceiling on interest rates for dong and dollar loans to promote industrial and credit growth.

The bank said in a statement that the ceiling on short-term dong loans would be reduced by 0.25 percentage points to 1.00 percent a month. The ceiling on medium- and long-term loans was also reduced 0.25 percentage points to 1.10 percent.
The ceiling for dollar lending was reduced by 1.0 percentage points per year to 8.5 percent.
